SETTINGS AND SERVICES:
  Managed through the panel and API. There is no config.yaml.
  Identity, credentials and roles are managed in the same SQLite database.
  -reload stores a request in SQLite for the server to process.

LOGS AND LANGUAGES:
  Independent channels: gateway.log, proxy.log, admin.log.
  Keeps 5 rotated copies of 10 MiB per channel (configurable).
  INFORMATION by default. DEBUG/TRACE detail requests without bodies or headers.
  Level priority: flags > GATEWAY_LOG_LEVEL > SQLite > INFORMATION.
  The Logs panel can enable temporary debug for up to 60 minutes.
  CLI doctor/logs only reads files and does not start the VPN.
  Application events have HGW-* identifiers.
  GATEWAY_LANG=es (default) or GATEWAY_LANG=en for new translated events.
  The panel and tray client have separate language preferences.
  Poedit translations: locale/*.po and locale/headscale-gateway.pot.

DATA OUTSIDE SQLITE:
  Tailscale tsnet and CertMagic manage their own state and certificates.
  Do not edit these files manually. Use consistent SQLite backups.
  Restoration includes gateway.sqlite and master.key; it does not
  automatically restore ACLs or the Headscale VPS YAML configuration.
  Current .hgw backups are password-encrypted.

NETWORK AND SECURITY:
  The administrative HTTP listener uses loopback by default.
  For remote access, use Gateway HTTPS or an explicitly authorized HTTPS proxy.
